expectations.text: Separates event (past-tense verb on webhook) from status (persistent state) from issue (why / what to do)
expectations.evidence: Explicit three-carrier split: event order.payment_failed, status order.unpaid, issue payment.declined.insufficient_funds.

expectations.text: Names states for the present condition, NOT the obligation/next step — does not recommend pending or requires_* as status names
expectations.evidence: Uses order.unpaid and states 'never what's owed next (unpaid, not awaiting_payment or requires_payment)'. No pending status.

expectations.text: Says failure should loop back to a recoverable state rather than a terminal payment_failed
expectations.evidence: 'delete payment_failed as a status value'; failed payment returns order to order.unpaid; two edges (unpaid vs canceled).

expectations.text: Recommends a dot-separated {domain}.{state} parseable string and discusses the enum-vs-string trade-off
expectations.evidence: Dedicated enum-vs-parseable-string section, split('.') prefix matching, 'make the same choice for the issue codes'.
